**Lint your Python architecture.** [![Package version](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/import-linter.svg)](https://pypi.org/project/import-linter) [![Python versions](https://img.shields.io/pypi/pyversions/import-linter.svg)](https://pypi.org/project/import-linter) [![CI status](https://github.com/seddonym/import-linter/actions/workflows/main.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/seddonym/import-linter/actions/workflows/main.yml) [![BSD license](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-BSD_2--Clause-orange.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/BSD-2-Clause)
**Import Linter** allows you to impose constraints on the imports between your Python modules. It also provides a browser-based user interface for exploring the architecture of any Python package.

Get started.
